summary.goal: Add relay SDK dependency and establish connection infrastructure to relay-daemon
summary.context: The @agent-relay/sdk package provides agent spawning, messaging, and MCP integration. Planner needs to connect to relay-daemon (via Unix Domain Socket) to spawn and communicate with planning agents.

acceptance_criteria.description: @agent-relay/sdk is added as dependency
Relay client can connect to relay-daemon
Connection health check endpoint exists at GET /api/health/relay
Graceful fallback when relay-daemon is not running (mock mode)
Environment configuration for relay socket path (RELAY_SOCKET_PATH)
Automatic reconnection when daemon becomes available

steps.title: Add relay SDK dependency
steps.description: Add @agent-relay/sdk to package.json dependencies. This package provides the client for connecting to relay-daemon.

acceptance_criteria.description: @agent-relay/sdk is in dependencies
npm install succeeds
TypeScript can import from @agent-relay/sdk/client

steps.title: Create relay configuration module
steps.description: Create src/relay/config.ts that exports relay configuration: socket path from RELAY_SOCKET_PATH env var with sensible default (e.g., /tmp/relay.sock or ~/.relay/daemon.sock).

acceptance_criteria.description: Exports getRelayConfig() returning { socketPath: string, reconnectInterval: number, maxReconnectAttempts: number }
RELAY_SOCKET_PATH env var overrides default
Default path works when env var not set

steps.title: Create relay client wrapper
steps.description: Create src/relay/client.ts that wraps @agent-relay/sdk/client. Export: connect(), disconnect(), isConnected(), getClient(). Handle connection errors gracefully - catch and log, don't throw.

acceptance_criteria.description: connect() establishes connection to daemon socket
disconnect() cleanly closes connection
isConnected() returns boolean connection status
Connection errors are caught and logged, not thrown
getClient() returns null when not connected

steps.title: Create relay availability service
steps.description: Create src/relay/service.ts that provides isRelayAvailable() check. This is the single source of truth for whether relay features are active. When unavailable, AI features should fall back to mock responses.

acceptance_criteria.description: isRelayAvailable() returns true only when connected to daemon
Exports RelayMode type: 'connected' | 'disconnected' | 'mock'
getRelayMode() returns current mode
onModeChange(callback) allows subscribing to mode changes

steps.title: Add relay health check endpoint
steps.description: Add GET /api/health/relay endpoint that returns { status: 'connected' | 'disconnected' | 'error', socketPath: string, message?: string }. This allows UI and monitoring to check relay status.

acceptance_criteria.description: GET /api/health/relay returns JSON: { status: 'connected' | 'disconnected' | 'error', socketPath: string, message?: string }
Returns 'connected' when daemon is running and connected
Returns 'disconnected' when daemon not available
Includes socketPath in response

steps.title: Implement automatic reconnection
steps.description: Add reconnection logic to relay client. When connection lost, attempt to reconnect at configurable interval. When daemon starts after Planner, client should eventually connect.

acceptance_criteria.description: Reconnection attempts occur at configured interval (default 5s)
Max reconnect attempts configurable (default unlimited)
Successful reconnection updates relay mode to 'connected'
Reconnection attempts logged but not noisy (backoff)

steps.title: Initialize relay on server startup
steps.description: Modify src/server.ts to attempt relay connection on startup. Log connection status. Do NOT fail if relay unavailable - the server should start in mock mode.

acceptance_criteria.description: Server attempts relay connection on startup
Server starts successfully even if relay unavailable
Console logs show relay connection status
Graceful shutdown disconnects relay

steps.title: Export relay module from index
steps.description: Create src/relay/index.ts that re-exports public API: connect, disconnect, isConnected, isRelayAvailable, getRelayMode, getRelayConfig. Update src/index.ts if needed.

acceptance_criteria.description: src/relay/index.ts exports public relay API
Other modules can import from './relay/index.js'

steps.title: Add unit tests for relay module
steps.description: Create src/relay/relay.test.ts with tests for: config loading, client connect/disconnect behavior, availability service, reconnection logic. Mock the @agent-relay/sdk to test without actual daemon.

acceptance_criteria.description: Tests for config module with/without env var
Tests for client wrapper with mocked SDK
Tests for availability service
Tests for reconnection logic
All tests pass with npm test

cases.description: Config loads with default socket path when RELAY_SOCKET_PATH not set
Config loads with custom socket path from RELAY_SOCKET_PATH env var
Client connects to daemon when socket available
Client disconnects cleanly
isConnected() returns true when connected, false when disconnected
getClient() returns client instance when connected
isRelayAvailable() returns true when connected to daemon
getRelayMode() returns 'connected' when daemon running
GET /api/health/relay returns { status: 'connected', socketPath } when connected
Successful reconnection after disconnect updates mode to 'connected'
Server starts and attempts relay connection on startup
Graceful shutdown calls disconnect()
connect() with invalid socket path logs error but does not throw
getClient() returns null when not connected
isRelayAvailable() returns false before connect() called
getRelayMode() returns 'disconnected' when daemon not running
onModeChange callback fires on connection state change
Reconnection uses exponential backoff (not noisy logs)
Max reconnect attempts respected when configured
Daemon starts after Planner - client eventually connects via reconnection
Connection failure logs error but server continues starting
Socket permission denied error caught and logged
GET /api/health/relay returns { status: 'disconnected' } when daemon unavailable
GET /api/health/relay returns { status: 'error', message } on connection error
Reconnection attempt failure does not crash server

data_requirements: Test Unix socket for integration tests (can use mock or temp socket)
Environment variable manipulation for config tests
